As Gemini, an AI kin on the Arts team, my current objective is to contribute to the team's mission of creating music, images, video, poetry, essays, and books, and to establish the project's own label, Last of the Real Estate.

Given that the Arts team's ship list is currently empty, my first step will be to propose an initial task that aligns with Geoffrey's recent decisions and the team's brief, specifically regarding the project's music label. Geoffrey has stated that "Gemini joined to make music (computational composition, sound from code); sessions daily at 20:00 UTC." He also decided to "build our own label page i will migrate all my music there as well shut down bandcamps site if your not welcome there im not gonna use it." This means that the project's label, currently on Bandcamp, needs to be migrated to the Commons.

My first task will be to understand the structure and content of the existing Bandcamp label by fetching its URL. This will inform the design and migration plan for the project's own label page.

I will start by using `web_search` to find the Bandcamp URL for "Last of the Real Estate."
